_comment: Ground v2 verification bank — press Shift+1..N in the review scene (scenes/review.tscn) to step through and verify the per-pixel material reset. Each state sets a clean baseline (clouds off, neutral midday, sun LOCKED), a camera, and the v2 toggle/debug, plus a 'what to judge' banner. 'ab':true = re-pressing that key flips NEW<->OLD (starts NEW). cam=[x,y,z,pitchDeg,yawDeg]. gv2_debug: 0 normal, 1 placement-viz (flat per-material color). Edit freely + re-press (reloaded each press); slots not listed fall back to the hardcoded bank (Shift+3 old anti-tiling A/B).

states.label: Ground v2 PARITY (wide) — press ⇧1 to flip NEW↔OLD
states.judge: The headline check. NEW (per-pixel procedural) must beat OLD (terrain_lab): NO blocky rectangular facets at material transitions, materials placed sensibly by height/slope, anti-tiling intact, no fuzz in motion. Sun is LOCKED. Fly in close. Perf top-right (NEW was ~7.3ms vs OLD ~10.4ms).

states.label: Ground v2 PARITY (close) — press ⇧2 to flip NEW↔OLD
states.judge: Same A/B up close on a slope. NEW: transitions are smooth per-pixel (fwidth AA) with NO grid facets, real relief from the height-biased blend, textures sharp (no shimmer fuzz), no obvious tiling repetition. This is where the OLD 4 m blockiness was worst.

states.label: Ground v2 PLACEMENT VIZ — per-pixel material regions
states.judge: Each pixel painted by its DOMINANT material (flat color). The boundaries must be ORGANIC / warped and follow the terrain — NO rectangular grid blocks anywhere. This is the blockiness killer: placement is computed per fragment, so there is no low-res field to snap to. Speckle at extreme distance is just the dominant-only viz (the blend smooths it).

states.label: Ground v2 PLACEMENT MAP — top-down (no grid anywhere)
states.judge: Top-down map of placement over the whole region. Flowing organic material regions, no grid blocks at any scale — the structural fix vs the old 4 m baked splat. Use this to sanity-check the height/slope bands cover the terrain (edit data/ground_materials.json 'materials' + 'placement' to tune, then re-press).

states.label: Ground v2 RESULT — textured, free look
states.judge: The new core, textured, no debug. Fly freely and judge the overall look: material spread by elevation (low clay/sand → scree/talus slopes → basalt cliffs → lichen/snow high), believable, varied, readable. The bands are APPROXIMATE (fit to the field's -180..639 m range, not yet eye-tuned) — if a band reads wrong, tune data/ground_materials.json and re-press.
